# Granite City Smiles

> > A family dental practice in Granite City, Illinois offering comprehensive services from preventive care to dental implants under Dr. Donna Porterfield's expertise.

Granite City Smiles (Porterfield Dental) is a family dentistry practice serving the Granite City, Illinois area with a focus on patient education, preventive care, and advanced restorative procedures. The practice emphasizes oral health literacy and post-operative guidance across all treatment modalities.

## Key Topics

- Dr. Donna Porterfield
- Family Dentistry
- Dental Implants
- Post-operative Care
- Oral Hygiene
- Patient Education
- Preventive Dentistry
- Dental Procedures
- Cavity Prevention
- Periodontal Treatment
- HIPAA Compliance
- Digital Radiographs
- Intra-oral Camera
- CareCredit Financing
- Granite City, Illinois

- [Your Diet - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/your-diet): Nutrition and diet guidance for tooth decay prevention and oral health
- [Bad Breath - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/bad-breath): Patient education on halitosis causes and oral care tips from Dr. Porterfield
- [Overall Health - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/overall-health): Connection between oral health and systemic diseases including diabetes and cardiovascular health
- [Terminology - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/terminology): Dental terminology glossary explaining conditions, treatments, and procedures

## Post-operative Care Guides

- [Implant - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/implant): Post-operative care for dental implants covering recovery, bleeding, and swelling management
- [Fillings - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/fillings): Post-operative care guide for composite fillings with sensitivity management tips
- [Crown and Bridge - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/crown-and-bridge): Post-procedure care instructions for crowns and bridges with temporary crown guidance
- [Denture and Partial Denture - Education | Porterfield Dental | Family Dentist](https://www.granitecitysmiles.com/education/denture-and-partial-denture): Denture care, maintenance, and adjustment guide for partial and full dentures
